consumer: The dialogue/condition has_items check (conditional_t::set_has_items) asking 'does the avatar carry the contraband item?' to gate the guard's search outcome.
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person possession, matching has_charges/has_amount reach), not a nearby/reachable-inventory search
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — builds an engine-computed possession predicate returning actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over the character actor, evaluating a yes/no the dialogue/condition consumes.
divergence: Avatar carries the contraband as a round loaded inside a magazine (or gun): visit_items/visit_internal skips gun/magazine contents, so a re-derivation from the snapshot's carried_items[] would report 'not carrying' while the engine has_amount predicate the guard consumes returns true.
